name: BK-5F-NM-AMT
summary: BK-5F-NM-AMT, or βk-5F-NM-αMT, also known as β-keto-5-fluoro-N-methyl-αMT or α,N-dimethyl-5-fluoro-β-ketotryptamine, is a monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine, α-alkyltryptamine, and β-ketotryptamine families.

pharmacology.text: BK-5F-NM-AMT, or βk-5F-NM-αMT, also known as β-keto-5-fluoro-N-methyl-αMT or α,N-dimethyl-5-fluoro-β-ketotryptamine, is a monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine, α-alkyltryptamine, and β-ketotryptamine families.

uses.en: It is a research compound studied for how it releases monoamines. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於探討它如何釋放單胺類物質，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于探讨它如何释放单胺类物质，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: It is the fluorine version of this small family, alongside the bromine and chlorine ones. Fluorine is the smallest of the halogens, so it changes the molecule's electronics far more than its shape.
fact.zh: 它是這個小家族中的氟取代版本，另外還有溴與氯的版本。氟是鹵素中最小的，因此它改變的主要是分子的電子性質，而非形狀。
fact.zhHans: 它是这个小家族中的氟取代版本，另外还有溴与氯的版本。氟是卤素中最小的，因此它改变的主要是分子的电子性质，而非形状。
